newsitem.title: USA: Shell Odessa, Tx crude unit down pending repair.
newsitem.headline: Shell Odessa, Tx crude unit down pending repair.

text.p: The crude distillation unit at Shell Oil Co's refinery in Odessa, Texas remains idled after Wednesday's fire, company and environmental officials said Thursday.
The unit, with a rated capacity of about 28,000 barrels per day (bpd), caught fire about 1100 CDT/1200 EDT on Wednesday. The fire was extinguished by 1300 CDT.

"There was a leak in one of the pipes at the crude distillation unit. (After the fire was put out) the rest of the plant was up and running but that unit is out until they replace (the damaged section)," an local environmental official said.
A Shell official confirmed the details but had no estimate of when the unit is expected back.
